title: RoboReward: General-Purpose Vision-Language Reward Models for Robotics
authors_zh: Tony Lee、Andrew Wagenmaker、Karl Pertsch、Percy Liang、Sergey Levine、Chelsea Finn
paper_type_zh: 机器人视觉语言奖励模型数据集与基准论文
best_for_zh: 训练或评测机器人视觉语言奖励模型，并研究可复用的轨迹奖励构造。
one_line: RoboReward turns real-robot videos into a five-level reward dataset and human-verified benchmark for general-purpose vision-language reward models.
RoboReward 将真实机器人视频转为五级进度奖励数据与人工核验基准，用于训练通用视觉语言奖励模型。
why: It makes a concrete human-feedback or reward object available for alignment research.
inclusion_reason: The paper releases or uses a public feedback artifact suitable for alignment training or evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Real-world robotic reinforcement learning requires accurate reward signals that can be queried repeatedly, but existing solutions usually depend on humans labeling individual episodes or on hand-crafted reward functions tuned separately for each task. These approaches are difficult to scale across robots, scenes, and language instructions. Although general-purpose vision-language models can inspect a rollout and judge task completion, their reliability on real robotic failures, near-misses, and partially completed tasks has not been systematically established.

The paper addresses this problem by constructing the RoboReward dataset and RoboRewardBench, which represent supervision as real-robot videos, natural-language task instructions, and discrete end-of-episode progress rewards from 1 to 5. It further augments success-heavy demonstrations through counterfactual instruction relabeling and temporal clipping, then trains general-purpose vision-language reward models that can supply rewards for robotic reinforcement learning.

真实机器人强化学习需要准确且可重复调用的奖励信号，但现有方案通常依赖人工逐回合标注，或针对单个任务反复调试手工奖励函数，难以扩展到不同机器人、场景和指令。通用视觉语言模型虽可观看轨迹并判断任务完成度，但其在真实机器人失败、近失误和部分完成状态上的可靠性仍缺少系统验证。

论文因此构建 RoboReward 数据集与 RoboRewardBench，将真实机器人视频、自然语言任务和 1–5 级回合末进度奖励组织为统一监督对象；同时通过反事实指令重标注和视频截断，为成功占多数的示范数据补充失败及近失误样本，并训练可直接为机器人强化学习提供奖励的通用视觉语言模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper’s central contribution is to transform scattered successful real-robot demonstrations into reusable supervision for training and evaluating general-purpose reward models. It keeps a rollout video fixed while generating alternative instructions that are only partially or not at all satisfied by the observed outcome, or truncates a successful trajectory to create intermediate completion states. The released RoboReward dataset contains 54,135 examples: 45,072 training examples, 6,232 validation examples, and 2,831 test examples. Each record includes a video, a task instruction, a discrete reward from 1 to 5, and the output of an automated validation check. The test set is additionally human-verified and released as RoboRewardBench. The dataset is used to fine-tune Qwen3-VL models at 4B and 8B scales and to evaluate 22 vision-language models.

论文的核心贡献是把分散的真实机器人成功示范转化为可训练、可评测的通用奖励监督：它保持轨迹视频不变，生成与视频结果不完全匹配的替代指令，或截断原始成功轨迹，从而构造不同完成程度的任务—视频—奖励记录。作者公开的 RoboReward 共含 54,135 条样本，其中训练集 45,072 条、验证集 6,232 条，测试集 2,831 条；每条记录包含视频、任务指令、1–5 级奖励及自动验证输出，测试集另经人工核验并作为 RoboRewardBench。该数据用于微调 Qwen3-VL 4B/8B，并评测 22 个视觉语言模型。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Aggregate and clean trajectories. The authors collect real-robot videos and task instructions from OXE and RoboArena and normalize surface-level errors in the instructions. Successful OXE demonstrations receive a reward of 5, while RoboArena’s human progress scores are mapped to the 1–5 rubric.
  2. Generate negative examples. For each successful video, the pipeline produces counterfactual tasks associated with rewards from 1 to 4. It also truncates videos at early, middle, and late endpoints to create failed, partially completed, and near-complete outcomes.
  3. Validate and split the data. GPT-5 mini checks whether each instruction, video, and reward are consistent with the fixed rubric; invalid sets are regenerated or discarded. Splits are constructed by original task description to prevent the same task from crossing train, validation, and test sets.
  4. Train and evaluate models. The Qwen3-VL vision backbone is frozen while its fusion and language layers are fine-tuned to predict end-of-episode rewards. Every test example is then manually verified. Reproduction requires fixed model versions, prompts, data sources, and splits; the complete generation-call budget and random seeds are not fully reported.

1. 汇集并清洗轨迹。 作者从 OXE 与 RoboArena 收集真实机器人视频和任务指令，修正指令表面错误；OXE 成功示范记为 5 分，RoboArena 人工进度分数映射为 1–5。
  2. 生成负例。 对成功视频生成对应 1–4 分的反事实任务，并按早、中、晚位置截断视频，构造失败、部分完成和近完成轨迹。
  3. 验证与划分。 GPT-5 mini 按固定量表检查指令、视频和分数是否一致，不合格样本重新生成或删除；数据按原始任务划分，避免同任务跨 split。
  4. 训练与评测。 冻结 Qwen3-VL 视觉骨干，微调融合层与语言层预测回合末分数；测试集逐条人工验收。复现需固定模型版本、提示词、数据源和切分；生成调用预算及随机种子未完整披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The main evidence is a controlled comparison of 22 vision-language models on the same RoboRewardBench. Every model receives a task instruction and a complete rollout video, predicts a progress score from 1 to 5, and is evaluated using mean absolute error against human-verified labels. RoboReward 8B achieves an overall MAE of 0.665, improving over its Qwen3-VL 8B base model at 0.892 and slightly outperforming GPT-5 mini at 0.691. The 4B model improves from 1.032 to 0.845. In two unseen WidowX tasks, 6,000 steps of reinforcement learning using RoboReward increase success from 5% to 50% and from 10% to 80%, respectively. These results support the value of targeted reward supervision, but the real-robot evaluation covers only two tasks with 20 evaluation trials per condition.

核心证据是在同一 RoboRewardBench 上比较 22 个视觉语言模型：输入均为任务指令和完整轨迹视频，输出 1–5 级进度分数，并以 MAE 衡量与人工核验标签的误差。RoboReward 8B 的总体 MAE 为 0.665，优于其基础架构 Qwen3-VL 8B 的 0.892，也略优于 GPT-5 mini 的 0.691；4B 模型由 1.032 降至 0.845。进一步在两个未见 WidowX 任务上训练 6,000 步后，RoboReward 奖励使成功率由 5% 提升至 50%、由 10% 提升至 80%。这些结果支持针对性奖励数据有效，但真实机器人实验仅覆盖两个任务、每项 20 次测试。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest common practice is to use a pretrained VLM to score behavior in one robotic environment, or to evaluate temporal value ordering only on successful expert videos. Such settings provide little supervision for real failures and near-misses across robots and tasks, and they do not adequately test whether a model distinguishes completion states relative to the specified instruction. RoboReward’s primary novelty is not the first use of VLMs as reward models. Instead, it combines counterfactual task relabeling, temporal clipping of the same trajectory, and a five-level progress rubric into a unified data-construction contract with a human-verified test set. It also evaluates 22 models across diverse embodiments under one protocol, shifting the contribution from a task-specific deployment method to a reusable dataset, benchmark, and general-purpose reward model.

最接近的共同做法是直接使用预训练 VLM 为单个机器人环境评分，或只在成功专家视频上评测时间价值顺序；这类设置缺少跨机器人、跨任务的真实失败与近失误监督，也难以检验模型是否真正按照指令区分不同完成状态。RoboReward 的关键变化不是首次使用 VLM 作为奖励模型，而是把反事实任务重标注、同轨迹时间截断和五级进度量表组合为统一的数据构造契约，并配套人工核验测试集。它还在统一设置下覆盖 22 个模型和多种机器人形态，使研究对象由单一部署方案转为可复用的数据集、基准与通用奖励模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html: First, automatically generated labels depend on GPT-5 mini correctly interpreting fine-grained spatial relations, action outcomes, and task constraints. If the validator mistakes an object hovering above a target for a completed placement, an incorrect score may remain in the training set. Reuse should therefore estimate false-acceptance rates for each reward level rather than treating automated acceptance as ground truth. Second, the method predicts a discrete reward only at the end of a complete episode, so it does not directly provide action-level or per-timestep credit assignment; long-horizon tasks may require an additional process-reward mechanism. Third, each benchmark example is accepted or rejected by one human annotator, and inter-annotator agreement is not reported. The real-robot RL study also covers only two WidowX tasks, so it does not establish universal reliability in open-world robotics.

第一，自动生成标签依赖 GPT-5 mini 对细粒度空间关系、动作结果和任务约束的判断；若验证模型把悬停误判为放置完成，错误分数仍可能进入训练集。复用时应抽样计算各奖励等级的误接受率，而不能把自动通过视为真实标签。第二，论文只预测完整回合的离散末端奖励，无法直接提供动作级或逐时间步信用分配，长时序任务可能需要额外过程奖励。第三，人工核验测试集由单名标注者逐条接受或拒绝，未报告标注者间一致性；真实机器人 RL 又仅验证两个 WidowX 任务，因此不能据此断言模型已在开放世界机器人任务中普遍可靠。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Researchers training robotic VLM reward models can directly fine-tune a model using RoboReward’s videos, tasks, five-level rewards, and validation outputs, then report MAE on RoboRewardBench. Success checks should include overall error, per-subset error, and gains over the corresponding base architecture under fixed conditions. Researchers who already possess successful demonstrations but lack failure data can reuse the counterfactual-instruction generation, video-clipping, and rubric-validation pipeline to produce reward records covering failures and near-misses, followed by a manual audit of automated validation errors. Existing VLMs can also be compared using the released prompts and 2,831 human-verified examples. The approach is unsuitable when the application requires per-action rewards, continuous control feedback, or success criteria that cannot be inferred from the rollout’s visible end state.

若研究者要训练机器人 VLM 奖励模型，可直接使用 RoboReward 的视频、任务、五级奖励和验证结果微调模型，并在 RoboRewardBench 上报告 MAE；成功标准应包括整体误差、各数据子集误差及相对基础模型的固定架构增益。若已有成功示范但缺少失败数据，可复用“反事实指令生成—视频截断—量表验证”流程，输出覆盖失败与近失误的奖励记录，并人工审计自动验证误差。若目标是评估现有 VLM，则可沿用统一提示词和 2,831 条人工核验样本比较模型。该方案不适合需要逐动作奖励、连续控制反馈或无法由视频末态判断成败的任务。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: RoboReward addresses the dependence of real-robot rewards on human labeling or hand-crafted objectives and the shortage of negative examples in successful demonstrations, producing a general-purpose reward dataset, benchmark, and 4B/8B models.
  2. Method handle: It normalizes task text, generates counterfactual instructions and clipped videos, and validates them under a fixed five-level rubric; rejection-based VLM validation is the step that most directly determines label quality.
  3. Data handle: The dataset contains 54,135 video–task–reward records, including 2,831 human-verified test examples, and is released under CC BY 4.0.
  4. Evidence anchor: The 8B model reaches 0.665 MAE on the benchmark and improves base-policy success by 45 and 70 percentage points on two real-robot tasks.
  5. Reuse decision: It is best suited to short-horizon manipulation tasks with visibly judgeable final states; automated label errors are the main risk, so samples should be manually audited separately for each reward level.

1. 一句话定位： RoboReward 解决真实机器人奖励依赖人工或手工函数、现有成功示范又缺少负例的问题，直接产出通用奖励数据、基准和 4B/8B 模型。
  2. 方法抓手： 先统一任务文本，再生成反事实指令与截断视频，最后用固定五级量表验证；真正决定标签质量的是拒绝式 VLM 检查。
  3. 数据抓手： 数据集含 54,135 条视频—任务—奖励记录，测试集 2,831 条均经人工核验，许可为 CC BY 4.0。
  4. 证据锚点： 8B 模型在基准上达到 0.665 MAE，并在两个任务上把基础策略成功率提高 45 和 70 个百分点。
  5. 复用决定： 最适合短时程、末态可见的操作任务；最大风险是自动标签误判，使用前应分奖励等级进行人工抽查。
